events.title: The Bureau Is Now Hiring — Meet Anomaly Control Simulator
events.summary: Hello everyone,We're Mind Creations — a small independent studio, and Anomaly Control Simulator is our debut title. After a long stretch of quiet work behind closed doors, we're incredibly excited to finally open up and share the project with you! How to stay close to the project:⭐ Wishlist the game right here on Steam - it genuinely helps us more than you might think💬 Join our Discord community https://discord.gg/QnYQTeyftj📡 Follow us for regular updates and dev diariesThank you for being here
